items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: The only one colored jockey I saw in the fireground, that was Simpson. I know him. I talked to him in the fireground.

ctx.x: Did they have colored jockeys here?
Had one here. None here now. They had one here. Bradley sent us a boy here a couple of years ago. He read here. Name was Simpson. He read out there.
That's recently, huh? How long ago was that?

items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: And Root kept that coffin... So me and the preacher went on our ceremony. And left him standing there.

ctx.x: Well they have some big trees out there I know.

Oh yeah. Well they rather one of them big trees. And Root kept that coffin. This boy right there. And he... He... We tried to get them to... Waiting for them to take the coffin out. And let him down right. But they stood there and we stood there. So me and the preacher went on our ceremony. And left him standing up there. They were laughing there. And he was on there.
What kind of ceremony is this?
